question: Which cloud model lets you run workloads on-premises and in a public cloud together?

options.explanation: A public cloud is run entirely by a third-party provider; it does not include your on-premises infrastructure.
A private cloud is dedicated to a single organisation and does not by itself include public cloud resources.
Correct — a hybrid cloud combines on-premises (private) infrastructure with public cloud resources so they work together.
A community cloud is shared by several organisations with common requirements, not a mix of on-premises and public cloud.

explanation: A hybrid cloud combines on-premises (private) infrastructure with public cloud resources, letting workloads move between them.
